ModMetaData.name: Vanilla Combat Overhaul
ModMetaData.author: cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Adds depth to RimWorld's combat without replacing it.
MELEE - Pawns can parry incoming attacks, and a good parry opens a counter-attack. - Hits from the side or behind do more damage. - Being outnumbered makes you easier to hit. - Attacks aim where the attacker can reach - a short pawn is not swinging at a tall one's head.
RANGED - Shooting skill matters more, and the gap between a good shot and a bad one is wider. - Moving targets are harder to hit than standing ones. - Missed shots go wide of the target rather than landing anywhere nearby, and spread further at long range. - Bullets and arrows wound differently - bullets by force, arrows by cutting deep. - Projectiles leave a short glowing trail, so you can see where fire is coming from. - Drafted shooters can pick a fire mode: Precision, Short Burst, Suppression, or Auto by distance. Enemies choose theirs too. - Incoming fire suppresses: pawns under fire aim worse and slower, and pinned enemies take cover.
ARMOUR - Armour that fails to stop a hit still reduces it, instead of the all-or-nothing vanilla roll. - Weapon armour penetration is shown on the weapon.
EQUIPMENT - Loadouts, set in the Assign tab, choose each colonist's weapons, a backup melee weapon, and items to carry. - Colonists upgrade their primary weapon by skill and switch to their sidearm when an enemy reaches them. - Manually equipped weapons remain locked until you allow automatic upgrades again.
CLOTHING - Gloves and boots protect hands and feet. Masks, helmets and glasses cover the face properly.
Combat and equipment systems can be configured individually in the mod settings.
Not compatible with Auto Arm, Combat Extended, Yayo's Combat, Vanilla Combat Reloaded, or Vanilla Fire Modes. With Simple Sidearms active, Simple Sidearms handles backup weapons and loadouts handle the rest. With another loadout mod, turn Loadouts off in the settings.
